name: What maintenance is required for textured stucco?
description: Textured stucco requires low maintenance, mainly regular cleaning. Periodically inspect for cracks or damage to prevent larger repairs.

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for textured stucco?

acceptedAnswer.text: Textured stucco is generally low maintenance. Regular cleaning, typically with a garden hose or a low-pressure power washer, can remove dirt and grime to keep it looking fresh. It's important to inspect your stucco periodically for any hairline cracks, chips, or signs of moisture intrusion, especially around windows and doors. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent larger, more costly repairs down the line and preserve the integrity and appearance of the textured finish.
